chunks: Ibn al-Athir said in his al-Kamil, vol. 9, p. 113; Abu al-Fida' in his Tarikh, vol. 2, p. 154; and Ibn al-Wardi in his Tarikh, vol. 1, p. 339, in the events of the year 413:
(And in it, Abu 'Abd Allah ibn al-Mu'allim, the jurist of the Imamiyyah, passed away, and [there was] the elegy of al-Murtada.)

key_terms.حَوَادِثِ: the events or occurrences of a given year
key_terms.سَنَةِ: the year being referenced in the chronicle
key_terms.فَقِيهُ: a jurist, a scholar of fiqh
key_terms.ٱلْإِمَامِيَّةِ: the Imamiyyah, the Twelver Shi'a community

ai.seo_question: What do historical sources say about the death of Abu 'Abd Allah ibn al-Mu'allim in 413 AH?
ai.summary: This passage cites historical works recording the death of Abu 'Abd Allah ibn al-Mu'allim in the year 413 AH. It identifies him as a leading jurist of the Imamiyyah and notes the elegy associated with al-Murtada, making the report biographical and historiographical in nature.
